key_insight: Neural PDE solvers can approach the optimal solution while their parameters diverge, so the best fit may not exist within the original model class.
engineering_relevance: For PDE optimization workflows, this means training can appear successful yet still fail to yield a finite, deployable parameterization unless the model class is completed appropriately.
method: Analyzes missing limits in deep tanh networks arising from unbounded hidden parameters or redundant neurons.
Characterizes the missing functions for translated-kernel models.
Restores attainability of the optimum by augmenting the model with kernel derivatives.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports numerical studies that track parameter growth and test how the proposed completion changes PDE optimization behavior.
watch_item: Model completion may improve attainability, but it adds extra basis terms and implementation complexity that must be matched to the PDE architecture.
paper_title: Singular parameters and missing limits in neural PDE solvers
